description: The compact window of the shell's quick verbs (Extract here, Extract to new folder, Add to archive; plan D6, owner decision 2026-10-16). Least privilege: five commands of its own and nothing else. watch_quick listens to the one running job (progress, a request for a passphrase, the result); quick_passphrase sends a passphrase once, into a zeroizing type in Rust, never a command line; quick_cancel stops the job; quick_show_folder opens the folder the job wrote into in the file manager (Rust remembers the path; the webview names none); quick_close closes the window. No fs, shell, http, dialog, or window permission is granted, core:default is not granted, and none of the main window's archive, staging, extract, or update commands is reachable from here.
